en.askTitle: Swap in your own dates and budget, and get a no-driving Iceland winter plan with a weather reserve
en.runTitle: Seven days in Iceland in February without driving: a Singapore couple on SGD 9,000

fields.label: Passport nationalities and prior Schengen stays
fields.value: Singapore passports (a couple in their early 30s)

fields.label: Budget excluding flights
fields.value: SGD 9,000 for two, excluding flights from Singapore

fields.label: Walking comfort
fields.placeholder: e.g. fine with 5 km walks, not on icy paths

fields.label: Dated quotes and fare terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. a 2-day South Coast tour quote read on 7 November, with its cancellation terms

en.template: Plan a no-driving Iceland winter trip for {passport}, {flights}, {budget} and {walking}. Compare a Reykjavík base plus guided coast overnight, using {quotes}. Keep a weather reserve, explain cave substitutions, aurora retries, lagoon transport and ETIAS checks. Ask before booking, contacting anyone or sharing my details.

phases.title: Research tours, hotels, getting around and official entry and weather information
phases.note: Tour operators, Reykjavík and South Coast hotels, airport transfers, Schengen and ETIAS rules

phases.title: Write the day-by-day guide, with dated sources and every calculation
phases.note: Reykjavík base plus a two-day guided South Coast trip, with weather buffers
phases.judgment: It kept the unknowns visible instead of filling them in: no February hotel availability was confirmed, two published Sky Lagoon prices disagreed, and the start date of the EU's new ETIAS travel authorisation is still unconfirmed.

phases.title: Independent budget check, then desktop and phone layout checks
phases.judgment: A separate reviewer re-added all 14 budget rows without redoing the research: ISK 737,468, or SGD 7,762.82, which leaves SGD 1,237.18 under the SGD 9,000 budget. It also priced the more expensive hotel option, SGD 8,904.93, which still fits.

workers: Looked for hotel rates in Reykjavík and on the South Coast for mid-February, and kept only those that had a real source
Read four tour operators' own pages for advertised prices, winter ice cave dates, and what happens if a tour is cancelled or no lights appear
Checked official entry rules for Singapore passports, ETIAS timing, airport bus fares, lagoon prices and winter clothing rental
Independent check of the budget arithmetic and whether the guide holds together, without doing new research

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的日期和预算，就能得到一份不自驾、带天气备用金的冰岛冬季行程
zh.runTitle: 二月去冰岛七天、不自驾：新加坡情侣，预算 9000 新币

fields.label: 护照国籍和既往申根停留
fields.value: 新加坡护照（两人都是三十出头）

fields.label: 航班日期和时间
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月中旬去冰岛 7 天

fields.label: 不含机票的预算
fields.value: 两人 9000 新币，不含新加坡出发的机票

fields.label: 步行承受能力
fields.placeholder: 例如：能走 5 公里，但不想走结冰的路

fields.label: 指定日期报价和票种条款
fields.placeholder: 例如：11 月 7 日查到的南岸两日团报价及其退改条款

zh.template: 为{passport}、{flights}、{budget}及{walking}规划冰岛冬季不自驾行程。根据{quotes}比较雷克雅未克基地加南岸跟团过夜。保留天气备用金，说明冰洞替换、极光重试、温泉交通和 ETIAS 核查。订购、联系任何人或分享我的资料前，先问我。

phases.title: 查旅行团、酒店、交通以及官方的入境和天气信息
phases.note: 旅行社、雷克雅未克和南岸酒店、机场接送、申根和 ETIAS 规定

phases.title: 写出逐日行程，附带日期的来源和每一笔计算
phases.note: 雷克雅未克做基地，加一次南岸两日跟团，并留出天气缓冲
phases.judgment: 没确定的地方它都摆在明面上，没有补空：二月的酒店空房没能核实，天空潟湖有两个公开价格对不上，欧盟新的 ETIAS 旅行授权什么时候启用也还没定。

phases.title: 独立核对预算，再检查电脑和手机上的页面
phases.judgment: 独立复核同事没有重新做调研，只把预算 14 行重新加了一遍：冰岛克朗 737,468，合 7,762.82 新币，比 9000 新币预算低 1,237.18。它还算了更贵的酒店方案，是 8,904.93 新币，仍在预算内。

workers: 查二月中旬雷克雅未克和南岸的酒店价格，只留下有真实来源的
读四家旅行社自己的页面：公布的价格、冬季冰洞日期，以及旅行团取消或没看到极光时怎么处理
核对新加坡护照的官方入境规定、ETIAS 时间、机场大巴票价、温泉价格和冬装租赁
独立检查预算算术和整份指南前后是否一致，不做新调研
